mutations.title: zero executed cases reported as PASS
mutations.detector: harness.finish converts a 0-case PASS to UNRESOLVED and fails the test
mutations.rationale: The Phase-1B requirement: an unexecuted test is not a pass.
mutations.evidence: pytest exit 1; E           AssertionError: [UNRESOLVED] MAT02 (1-data-integrity): claims a pass without executing anything; E             detail:   FORCED UNRESOLVED: 0 cases executed, so a PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE would be unevidenced.

mutations.title: incorrect characteristic-matrix parity (e33 sign in M[1,2])
mutations.detector: M(-xi) = S M(xi) S must fail for the unique admitted S
mutations.rationale: This is the Phase-1 defect class: a coupling sign that breaks parity.
mutations.evidence: parity entries broken by the mutation: 1
mutations.control_evidence: parity entries broken by the mutation: 0

mutations.title: incorrect heat-flux expression (linear thermal term)
mutations.rationale: The Phase-1 P0 defect, re-injected. The detector is the Second-Law balance, which shares no amplitude with the flux.
mutations.evidence: D2 status under the mutated flux: UNRESOLVED
mutations.control_evidence: mutation did not apply (no marker found)

mutations.title: wrong polynomial coefficient ordering
mutations.detector: the returned roots must not satisfy det M = 0
mutations.rationale: polyroots expects descending coefficients; feeding ascending ones returns roots of a different polynomial.
mutations.evidence: worst relative polynomial residual at the returned roots: 1.000e+00
mutations.control_evidence: worst relative polynomial residual at the returned roots: 1.398e-41

mutations.title: incorrect incident/outgoing mode selection
mutations.detector: _admissible must not return a growing mode
mutations.rationale: Swapping the two root families selects the wrong half-space modes and silently produces a scattering matrix with the wrong boundary data.

mutations.title: wrong material units (Pa entered as GPa)
mutations.detector: the implied longitudinal speed must leave the physically admissible band
mutations.rationale: A silent 1000x unit error changes every dimensionless group.
mutations.control_evidence: DAT01 exit 0; no cross-source mismatch reported

mutations.title: inappropriate isotropic benchmark on an anisotropic medium
mutations.detector: PZT-5H must be shown to violate sagittal isotropy
mutations.rationale: The Fresnel formula is only valid for isotropic media; PZT-5H is not.
mutations.evidence: an isotropic closed form was evaluated on PZT-5H, which is not isotropic: R 0.0726435209266035 T 0.9273564790733965 SUM 1.0
mutations.control_evidence: no isotropic proxy present, so nothing was misapplied

mutations.title: incorrect interface sign (transmitted block sign lost)
mutations.detector: the 8x8 interface operator must not retain full rank
mutations.rationale: The transmitted half-space contributes with the opposite sign; losing it makes two columns degenerate.
mutations.evidence: interface operator rank with the sign defect: 8 (rank is INSENSITIVE to this defect); sign defect present in the assembled operator: True
mutations.control_evidence: interface operator rank with the sign defect: 8 (rank is INSENSITIVE to this defect); sign defect present in the assembled operator: False

mutations.title: missing mandatory evidence artifact
mutations.rationale: An evidence package with a missing registry is not a package.
mutations.evidence: artifact test exit 1 after deleting the registry
mutations.control_evidence: artifact test exit 0 after deleting the registry

mutations.title: wrong source/data checksum
mutations.rationale: Silent edits to frozen inputs are the failure mode checksums exist for.
mutations.evidence: checksum test exit 1 with one hash corrupted
mutations.control_evidence: checksum test exit 0 with one hash corrupted

mutations.title: claim promoted to VERIFIED while its test no longer executes it
mutations.detector: the audit must find the claim VERIFIED against a test that does not compute the asserted quantity
mutations.rationale: This is U-11 itself: the defect the whole registry exists to prevent.
